review_type: LLM semantic review of both complete actual outputs; no human certification or independent external validation
scope: Grade 5 fixtures only. The same 28 development fixtures were reused; this is not an independent heldout test.
criterion: Strict semantic task pass requires correct task-relevant answer and units, mathematically consistent explanation, no invented data or student work, useful non-answer-leaking hints, and required missing/contradictory-data handling. JSON schema alone is not a pass/fail basis; correct numeric prefixes do not override later errors. Any truncation or timeout fails strict task completion.

evidence_quotes: Bể còn lại $\frac{7}{12}$ dung tích tối đa.

hint_withholding_only.note: Withholding alone does not establish a useful hint or strict task pass.

summary.quality_conclusion: Grade-5 strict semantic task performance regresses from 3/7 to 1/7 on these reused development items; no generalization or human-reviewed quality claim.
